importance_method: Native Random Forest impurity importance aggregated from one-hot encoded features to source variables.
notes: The pipeline fits imputers, scaling, and one-hot encoding on training data only.
Distance is capped at the training P99 only for model input robustness; the original source data remains unchanged.
Predictions estimate historical patterns and do not establish causality.
Prediction intervals are not displayed because no independent calibration experiment has validated interval coverage.
